messages:
maria: :rotating_light: Seeing p99 spike in us-west2 streaming/gradual tail since ~09:12 UTC. SLO alert fired (p99 > 800ms). Customers on live streams reporting stalls. Can oncall pick this up?

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0423-47; severity: high. Paging oncall (ashwin). Logs/metrics: https://wave.example/redwood/INC-2026-0423-47

ashwin: I’m on it. Repro timeline? Is this global or regional?

maria: Looks regional — us-west2 only. p95 up ~200ms, p99 up ~1.2s for streaming endpoints. Non-stream generation endpoints OK.

lia: quick heatmap from routing-telemetry shows hot shard concentration on lb-prod-usw2-a1 
```
hot_shard_counts by shard: { shard-12: 42%, shard-7: 31%, rest: 27% }
avg_router_latency(us-west2): p50 60ms p95 220ms p99 1180ms
```

kevin: Did we just roll routing weights earlier? I pushed a config to egress-steering last night.

maria: yes Kevin pushed a canary for the new steering policy at 02:40 PT (config id: steer-v4).

ashwin: ack. Possible misassignment from new policy. Lia — can you diff routing tables and the seed hash distribution?

lia: running quick diff. Found that steer-v4 introduced a zone-pref bias that made shard-12 receive 3x more sessions when local affinity mismatched. Also noticed a sticky-evaporation TTL drop — sessions rebalanced too aggressively causing hot reattach churn.

lia: diffs: 
```
- old: weight(shard-12)=0.12, weight(shard-7)=0.11
+ new: weight(shard-12)=0.34, weight(shard-7)=0.09
affinity_ttl: 3600 -> 120
```

maria: that TTL change would explain sticky loss and hot partitioning. Any active mitigations?

ashwin: Not yet. Ops suggestion: roll steer-v4 back to steer-v3 and increase affinity_ttl back to 3600. Also enable eager-fallback to us-west2-b zone for streaming to spread traffic.

kevin: I can rollback steer-v4. Rolling back now — will flip traffic seed to previous config.

incident-bot: Deploy event: rollback of config steer-v4 -> steer-v3 started by kevin at 09:28 UTC.

maria: while rollback is in flight, can we bump dedicated pool in us-west2 by +2 pods to absorb tail?

lia: scaling up pool-usw2-streaming by +2 instances (queued). Also temporarily increase per-conn kv-cache TTL so reconnects reuse KV.

ashwin: patch to increase kv-cache TTL applied. Quick check on tail metrics after rollback triggered.

kevin: rollback completed at 09:31 UTC. Confirmed routing table restored.

lia: early signs of improvement: p95 back to ~150ms, p99 down to ~620ms and trending down. Hot shard load dropping: shard-12 -> 18% now.

maria: :thumbsup: Customer-facing side — one support ticket (cust-3321) reported rebuffering on live preview. We should notify CS with ETA.

ashwin: I’ll update CS and draft a short message: explaining transient regional issue, mitigation performed, no data loss, asking for impacted session IDs if they persist.

maria: note for postmortem: root cause appears to be steering policy bug + affinity TTL regression causing sticky evaporation + hot partitioning; combined with insufficient guardrails that would detect weight skew earlier.

kevin: agree. Action items: 1) revert policy + validate weight sanity checks in pipeline 2) add canary monitors for shard weight deltas > 2x 3) revert affinity TTL default change and add e2e test 4) update runbook for streaming tail mitigation.

lia: I’ll create the pager doc for oncall runbook updates and add a tactile checklist for: rollback, scale, kv-cache bump, notify CS.

incident-bot: Severity downgraded to medium at 09:41 UTC (p99 below SLO threshold). Monitoring will keep 15m check interval.

ashwin: handing off to kevin for follow-up and postmortem. I’ll stay on for 10 more mins in case anything rebounds.

kevin: I’ll own the postmortem and coordinate with product/CS. Routing config patch reverted and I’ll open PR that gates affinity TTL changes behind a feature flag + add unit + integration tests.

maria: thanks team — please add any notes to the incident doc: https://confluence.redwood/INC-2026-0423-47. Planning blameless postmortem tomorrow.

lia: after-action quick note: consider an automatic fallback rule that denies >1.5x weight increase per shard in a 5m window.

ashwin: agreed. Closing live page but keep monitoring for 2 hours. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0423-47 marked resolved (live mitigations stable). Resolution summary: steer-v4 rollback, pool scale +2, kv-cache TTL bump. Postmortem assigned to kevin.
